description.value: Zawa Restaurant has anchored the south end of Commercial Drive since 1997, serving an eclectic mix of Mediterranean, American, and Middle Eastern cuisine in a newly renovated space with comfortable indoor booths and a large heated patio. The bar pours from 12 taps and a full liquor menu, and the venue regularly hosts live music, stand-up comedy, and sports on big-screen TVs. With seating for up to 90 and a lively neighbourhood vibe, it's a substantial fuelling stop on one of Vancouver's most famous cycling corridors.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully fetched and confirms a real, operating restaurant at 920 Commercial Dr, Vancouver, with phone +1 604-255-0470 corroborated across multiple pages. The about page establishes a long history (since 1997, formerly Zesty Restaurant), up to 90 seats, indoor booths, a large heated patio, and 12-tap bar. No explicit mention of bike parking, water refill, or washrooms appears anywhere in the website content; however, the menu explicitly lists gluten-free bread as a substitution and vegetarian breakfast options.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; phone +1 604-255-0470 was sourced from the website only, so contact_confirmed.phone is null rather than true.
Website copyright footer reads 2022, which may indicate the site is not actively maintained, though content appears substantive and current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible full-service restaurant and bar on Commercial Drive — a key cycling route in Vancouver. Clearly operational with a functioning website, online reservations, and detailed menu.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists gluten-free bread as a paid substitution option and breakfast items include veggie choices (mushroom, spinach, or tomato); multiple salads and plant-forward dishes appear throughout the menu

wow_evidence: anchored the south end of Commercial Drive since 1997
